releases.notes:
- Opening a chest of drawers or a kitchen drawer no longer hides the block standing on top of it.
- Doors, lids and drawers knock shut as they meet the frame, not half a second later.
- Each drawer of a chest of drawers or a kitchen drawer makes its own sound, also with the other one already out.
- Needs [Diegesis](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/diegesis) 1.0.0-beta.15.

releases.notes:
- Electricity generators open by hand: fuel goes on the grate behind the side panel, a key switches them on and the screen shows the fuel left.
- Mail boxes open by hand: the front comes down on the mail lying inside, and letting it down checks the mail.
- A microwave heats only with its door shut, beeps as it starts and switches itself off when everything is heated.
- The fridge, microwave and oven light up inside and light the room around them.
- A freezer, microwave or stove switched on without power now says so.
- A right click puts one of the stack in your hand down; the rest stays in the hand.
- Shift-clicked things go onto the middle of the microwave's plate and turn with it.
- A cupboard, fridge or cooler no longer goes dark inside the moment you shut it: it shuts as its door meets the frame.
- Flat things lie on their back in the kitchen drawer, chest of drawers and cooler, readable from above, and pile up.
- Putting things in is calmer: piles move as one, things never pass through each other and flat things turn to any angle.
- A lava bucket burnt in a generator leaves its empty bucket instead of losing it.
- Players without this mod on a server with it can shift-click in the menus of the freezer, microwave, stove and generator again.
- A comparator reads furniture as full when the slots of its menu are full, as without this mod.
- Needs [Diegesis](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/diegesis) 1.0.0-beta.14.

mods.description: Open MrCrayfish's furniture with your hands: put things on its shelves anywhere, turned and sized as you like.

releases.notes:
- Coolers, storage cabinets and chests of drawers open by hand too, in every wood and colour, and hold more than their
  menus.
- A cooler's lid swings up and rocks back onto its hinge, and what you put in lies on its floor where you set it.
- Microwaves open by hand: things stand on the plate, which turns while the microwave heats.
- Stoves open by hand: things stand on the oven's floor and rack, and three bake at once wherever they stand.
- Microwaves and stoves show what they hold through their windows, also in the world.
- The freezer, the microwave and the stove have their own power switch on them, in their finish; the microwave's green
  lamp shows it is on.
- The freezer freezes what you put in wherever it stands, and what comes out frozen stands beside it.
- Refurbished's wrench links furniture to power again: with it in hand, using the furniture no longer opens it.
- What a hopper, a command or another mod puts into furniture shows inside at once, for everyone near.
- Things that come in by a shift-click or a hopper stand where you can see them.
- Nothing goes through the shut glass door of a microwave or an oven.
- From the fridge, S goes down to its freezer, and W goes back up.
